shellCommands.command: git status --short && git ls-files | head -100 && echo "---" && grep -rniE "theme|тем" --include=*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx,html,css,vue,svelte,json,md} . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git -l 2>/dev/null | head -50

cat package.json && echo "--- index.html" && cat index.html && echo "--- App.tsx" && cat src/App.tsx && echo "--- main.tsx" && cat src/main.tsx && echo "--- vite-env" && cat src/vite-env.d.ts && echo "--- tsconfig" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "--- vite" && cat vite.config.ts && echo "--- gitignore" && cat .gitignore
ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "exit=$?"; (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 || npm install --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1) | tail -5

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; cat $D/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls $D/build 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; find $D -name "*.d.ts" -path "*ThemeProvider*" | head; echo ---; grep -rn "theme" $D/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; find $D -path "*theme*" -name "*.d.ts" | grep -v node_modules/.*/node_modules | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $D/theme/types.d.ts; cat $D/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo ---; ls $D | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo ---; cat $D/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts; cat $D/theme/useSystemTheme.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat $D/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $D/theme/ThemeProvider.js; echo ---; cat $D/theme/dom-helpers.js 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---; cat $D/controls/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find $D -name "SegmentedRadioGroup*.d.ts" | head; echo ---; cat $D/theme/index.d.ts; echo; grep -n "export" $D/index.d.ts | head -5

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $D/theme/constants.js | head -30; echo ---; cat $D/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; echo ---; cat $D/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles/styles.css 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ 2>/dev/null; grep -o "g-root[^{]*{[^}]*background[^}]*}" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo ---; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright

S=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css; wc -c $S; grep -n "root" $S | head -20; echo ---; grep -n "background" $S | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes | head; echo ---; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; command -v chromium || command -v chrome || echo "no system browser"

grep -n "ControlGroupProps\|ControlGroupOption" -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; ls node_modules | grep -iE "^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$"; echo "exit $?"

mkdir -p /tmp/e2e && cd /tmp/e2e && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright@1 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 300 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
(npx vite --port 5173 --strictPort > /tmp/e2e/vite.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; cat /tmp/e2e/vite.log | tail -5; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/

id -u; (sudo -n true 2>/dev/null && echo SUDO_OK) || echo NO_SUDO; (sudo -n apt-get install -y -q libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libdrm2 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libasound2 > /tmp/e2e/apt.log 2>&1 && echo APT_OK) || (tail -3 /tmp/e2e/apt.log 2>/dev/null; echo APT_FAILED)
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund jsdom@25 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -3; git status --short; ls node_modules/jsdom >/dev/null && echo JSDOM_OK
pkill -f "vite --port 5173" 2>/dev/null; timeout 240 npx vitest run src/__theme_check__.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -60
timeout 240 npx vitest run --config /tmp/e2e/vitest.config.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -60
rm -f src/__theme_check__.test.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -4 && rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff
